paragraphs.text: Jeremiah Isgur is a former employee from Wizards of the Coast . He worked consecutively as a Marketing Manager (2007-2008), Web Producer (2008-2011), and Senior Technical Producer of customer engagement systems — the group responsible for the technology behind Magic Organized Play (2011-2016).
As a storyline author, Isgur contributed to the Uncharted Realms for Theros and Khans of Tarkir .
